bio_en: Zhongzheng Cao is a master's student at AI4Rad Lab, Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital, SJTU School of Medicine. Research focuses on medical imaging artificial intelligence, musculoskeletal radiology, bone tumor X-ray analysis, and clinical validation of AI models.
bio_cn: 曹中正，上海交通大学医学院附属第六人民医院 AI4Rad 实验室硕士研究生。研究方向为医学影像人工智能、骨肌影像分析、骨肿瘤 X 线分析以及医学 AI 模型的临床验证。
interests_cn: 骨肿瘤 X 线智能分析
